description: This file defines the API and data structures for querying CPU features on various architectures within the Starboard platform. It includes enums, structs, and function declarations related to CPU architecture, capabilities, and specific features for ARM, MIPS, and x86 architectures.

methods.name: SbCPUFeaturesGet
methods.description: Retrieves the CPU features and populates the provided SbCPUFeatures structure with architecture-specific details.
